name: Industrial Wire & Cable Corporation
old_description: For over 60 years, Industrial Wire & Cable Corp and Industrial Wire & Cable II Corp. have been a family-owned and operated manufacturer of premium copper wire and cable. From our 100,000 sq. ft. facility in Lake Zurich, IL, we pair cutting-edge equipment with generations of expertise to ensure dependable, high-quality products.
about:
Industrial Wire & Cable Corporation, together with its sister company Industrial Wire & Cable II Corp., has operated from Lake Zurich, Illinois since 1962. The business was founded by Raymond Calabrese and remains family-owned, now led by his son Carl Calabrese as president and owner, marking over 60 years of continuous operation.

The company manufactures premium copper wire and cable from a 100,000-square-foot facility, combining fabrication and wire insulation processes with cutting-edge equipment. Production capabilities span custom wire and cable configurations, though specific volume ranges and headcount are not disclosed.

The firm serves customers in the solar power sector, evidenced by its president's appearance at the Solar Power International Show, and has been featured in trade publications associated with Niefhoff-Gruppe, a German machinery builder. Its customer base includes buyers seeking custom wire and cable specifications across industrial applications.

The family-owned company emphasizes its multi-generational expertise paired with current technology as a differentiator, aiming to deliver dependable, high-quality products. A quoted response time of one business day for inquiries reflects its service approach.
